description: G1 Dirichlet steady-state oracle: slab with c(0)=c0, c(L)=cL, no traps, no source, constant D.
provenance: Params are hand-picked (D=1e-9 m^2/s, L=1e-3 m, c0=1.0 mol/m^3, cL=0.0 mol/m^3). Steady T1 with constant D gives d2c/dx2=0, hence c(x)=c0+(cL-c0)x/L (G1); J_ss=-D(cL-c0)/L=1e-6 mol/m^2/s; inventory I=(c0+cL)L/2=5e-4 mol/m^2. Profile evaluated in float64 at five nodes; algebraic gate tolerance 1e-12.
